csv_project_name: Design For Bartlesville Airport Construct New Hangars
csv_scope_of_work: The Oklahoma Department of Aerospace & Aeronautics may be seeking a consultant to provide a Design For Bartlesville Municipal Airport Construct New Hangars. The Overall Development Objective (ODO) of the proposed project is to construct new hangars as part of the Statewide Hangar Program. Airport hangar space is in great demand. This project will increase storage capacity and support airport growth through the construction of new hangars. This is in support of a statewide effort to increase revenue generating hangar facilities at airports across the state.
